title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Global Partnership Centre (GPC) works to ensure that local communities and organisations lead the way in responding to crises and building long-term development solutions. We support local groups with the tools, knowledge, and partnerships they need to create lasting change. By collaborating with governments, civil society, community organisations, academic and research institutions, and businesses, we help communities access essential services and build resilience for the future. The GPC oversaw a diverse partnership portfolio of 158 local partners at the conclusion of 2024. Gender equality is mainstreamed throughout all GPC supported activities, one example being Community of Practice (CoP) webinars with local partners on building their capacities on gender equality, with the aim of enabling them to mainstream gender equality in their interventions.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 3: People Have Food & Nutrition Security. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The GPC facilitates strategic networking and collaboration between humanitarian and development partner agencies, through networking events, Communities of Practice (CoPs), 'Systems Thinking' workshops.
